items.author: Derek Bodner

Tyrese Maxey, on the lift Anfernee Simons gave them:
"Huge. Big shots by five. He did a good job. We're looking for him. When he gets in the game, we're hunting for him. We want him to hunt his shots, and he did a good job with that tonight.”

Nick Nurse called second-half threes from Anfernee Simons + Kentavious Caldwell-Pope “incredibly huge.”

“I thought we were generating a bunch of wide-open threes and just nobody could throw one in. And those guys kind of broke through on that and moved the scoreboard for us.”
